We want to inform you that soon 10 of our products will be free! Hurray! We want to do this from January 23th, 2023, 11:00 AM PST.[/b]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32998990/51b71fa00538e81edec58be917eb17370ed7e305.png[/img]

[b]In honor of the fifth anniversary of our games, the following products will be free:
1. Cyberemo 2007 Director's Cut
2. Cyberemo 2007 Soundtrack
3. SOK PRO Upgrade
4. SOK MAX PRO
5. SOK MIN PRO
6. SOK PRO MAX
7. SOK PRO MIN
8. SOK PRO SEX
9. Welcome Back To 2007 2 Director's Cut

Stay tuned. Thanks![/b]

notes.title: Remake and plans for 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Remake and plans for 2023:[/h1]

[h3]Hi! In 2023, we will delight you with three major and absolutely free events![/h3]

[h3]1. Welcome Back To 2007 Soundtrack[/h3] [b]The soundtrack will be absolutely free for everyone from January 9th, 2023, Monday. If you have already bought an add-on, then you can make a refund through the standard procedure, or you can leave everything as it is and we will be grateful to you =)[/b]

[h3]2. Welcome Back To 2007 - Classic Greenlight Edition[/h3] [b]The add-on will also be absolutely free for everyone from January 9th, 2023, Monday. If you have already bought an add-on, then you can make a refund through the standard procedure, or you can leave everything as it is and we will be grateful to you =)[/b]

[h3]3. Welcome Back To 2007[/h3] [b]The main game will get a full Remake absolutely for free. We plan to release a Remake in 2023. 
The game will completely change its engine, get statistics support, controller support, leaderboards, a modern interface and support for modern graphics. We will also remove bugs such as character sliding. And much, much more![/b]

[h3]Why are we doing this?[/h3]
[b]In 2023, on May 9th, our game turns 5 years old. And in this way we wanted to please the players and thank everyone for their support!
Stay tuned for updates =)[/b]

[h3]Thank you very much![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/666940/Welcome_Back_To_2007/

notes.title: Info about Price
notes.content:
[h1][b]People frequently ask us about price of our game. But now we haven't any possibility to open preorder:[/b][/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/games/666940/announcements/detail/1482112225742568925
[b]Due to that reason the price of the product is not visible to potential buyers. So we decided to make a post about price for our game in some regions.

Let's start with the fact that each region will have its own price. But for each region price will be minimal and approximately equal 0.99$.

A few examples of prices:[/b]
[list][*]Russia - [b]29[/b] RUR
[*]Ukraine - [b]19[/b] UAH
[*]Some other CIS - [b]0.79[/b] $
[*]Kazakhstan - [b]250[/b] tenge
[*]USA - [b]0.99[/b] $
[/list]

[b]Regional prices are subject of Steam General policies of local prices.
We as developers are unable to regulate them. Prices determined in cause of unified tariff, and with Steam recommendations.[/b]

[h1][b]And most importantly!
Don't forget that our game will get a 40% discount at the beginning of selling in all regions.
Receive and sign it, guys! =)[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Pre-order information
notes.content:
[h1][b]Information about the pre-order of the game:[/b][/h1]
[b]At this stage, we (the game developers) do not have the technical ability to open pre-order on the page of the game on Steam.
And it's not our fault that this service is not provided to us by the service itself.
The game can be purchased immediately at the time of release, and at any time in the future.[/b]
